content: {"episode_id":"ep-05003","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for CPT 93229 based on recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery. The clinical indication note documents concern for an arrhythmic etiology underlying these syncopal events and an order for mobile cardiac telemetry to capture any transient rhythm disturbances during daily activities. The current CO-197 denial concerns missing prior authorization; this appeal submits the documented clinical justification without asserting that authorization was obtained."}
